title: Variant decision cards and compact canary screens for quickstart
creator: Ava Patterson
description: Deliver a compact, production-ready set of onboarding visuals and in-console screenshots that demonstrate the variant decision flow (canary -> A/B -> fallback). This ticket covers: 1) a compact 'variant decision card' component used in quickstart and in the rollout list, 2) a condensed canary flow modal and its responsive states (mobile/tablet/desktop), 3) a fallback-policy summary ribbon used when higher-tier variants are unavailable, 4) annotated documentation screenshots for the quickstart guide (step-by-step), 5) localization-ready microcopy for EN/FR/JA, and 6) accessibility checks and export-ready asset bundles for handoff. The goal is to provide a minimal visual vocabulary for engineers and PMs to embed into the quickstart docs and Console help panels without adding cognitive load to new users.
design_notes: Use existing design tokens: color-primary-600 for action, color-warning-500 for canary state, color-muted-300 for disabled variant chips. Compact card height should be 72px with 12px internal spacing; avatar slot reserved for model icon (24px). Provide three visual states: default, promoted (pinned), degraded (fallback). Export assets at 1x/2x/3x in PNG and SVG versions where appropriate. Include a static sprite for the fallback ribbon and an optional 600ms GIF for the demo page. Microcopy must be parameterized ({{variantName}}, {{percent}}) for i18n. Markup annotations use the existing Console component class names for dev handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains finalized compact card, canary modal, and fallback ribbon components
All screenshots exported and uploaded to Drive in @1x/@2x/@3x PNG and SVG where applicable
Microcopy reviewed and approved by PM (Maya Singh) and localized for EN/FR/JA
Accessibility checks passed: contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for UI elements, keyboard nav proven for modal and card actions
Dev handoff doc attached with CSS tokens, export sizes, and a minimal markup example
Related PRs in console repository reference this ticket and use provided assets
